about.title: It started with her mother's insurance.
text: Jennifer King founded JLS after navigating confusing insurance systems for her mother, and built the agency on an education-first approach.
Most people come to us with one question, usually about Medicare, and we then look at the whole picture, sometimes telling clients to leave things as they are.
Ron Wordekemper, a licensed agent in Texas, explains complex insurance and retirement options clearly, and Leeanna King, our office manager, is often the first friendly voice you reach.
